summary: Practise emissions inventory checks, reduction planning, and carbon-credit screening. Explore the course and its practical work products.
lede: Carbon-credit training helps sustainability, finance, procurement, and emissions professionals assess organizational emissions and compare reduction and credit options. You’ll review inventory data, analyze abatement costs, screen credit quality, and compare internal carbon-pricing approaches. Practical exercises also cover procurement controls and decision briefs, with attention to documenting evidence, assumptions, and unresolved issues for finance and leadership.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who handle emissions data, reduction decisions, carbon-credit procurement, or related reporting and need a practical basis for evaluating options.
